chunks: And what is in it from Juwayriyyah ibn Musahhar concerning the return of the sun for the Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) after the passing of the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him and his family) — I have transmitted it from my father and Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan (may Allah be pleased with them both) who said: Sa'd ibn Abdullah narrated to us, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn 'Isa, from Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Ahmad ibn Abdullah Al-Qurawi, from Al-Husayn ibn Al-Mukhtar Al-Qalansi, from Abu Basir, from Abdul Wahid ibn Al-Mukhtar Al-Ansari, from Umm Al-Miqdam Al-Thaqafiyyah, from Juwayriyyah ibn Musahhar.

key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤَمِنِينَ: Commander of the Faithful, title for Imam Ali (as)
key_terms.جُوَيْرِيَةُ بْنُ مَسْحَرٍ: Juwayriyyah ibn Musahhar, a prominent companion of the Imams
key_terms.رَدِّ الشَّمْسِ: Return of the sun, a specific miracle/event

ai.seo_question: Who is the narrator chain for the hadith about the return of the sun for Imam Ali (as)?
ai.summary: Shaykh al-Saduq uses this introductory segment to authenticate the famous event of the 'Return of the Sun' (Rujūʿ al-Shams) by providing a robust chain of narrators (isnād) linking Juwayriyyah ibn Musahhar to the Prophet and Imam Ali (as). This specific transmission highlights the scholarly rigor of the Kufan tradition, emphasizing the reliability of key figures like Sa'd ibn Abd Allah and Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa in preserving this miraculous sign of Imam Ali's authority after the Prophet's death.
